story.title: INEC extends the election staff application deadline

sources.title: INEC Updates Closing Date for INECPRESS Ad-Hoc Staff Recruitment
sources.evidence: INEC extended the application deadline for ad hoc election staff from 18 November to 2 December 2026. The original 18 November cutoff was replaced by a date two weeks later.

sources.title: Extension of deadline for the registration of ad hoc staff on the INECPRES portal
sources.evidence: The accompanying statement identifies INECPRES as the recruitment portal for temporary staff for the 2027 general election.

story.explanation: INEC extended the application deadline for ad hoc election staff from 18 November to 2 December 2026.
story.context: The accompanying statement identifies INECPRES as the recruitment portal for temporary staff for the 2027 general election.
story.significance: The original 18 November cutoff was replaced by a date two weeks later.
story.openQuestion: Has INEC published a later change to the application window?

quiz.prompt: What deadline did INEC announce for recruitment applications?
quiz.explanation: INEC extended the application deadline for ad hoc election staff from 18 November to 2 December 2026.

story.title: INEC publishes state assembly candidate lists

sources.title: Updated list of candidates for 2027 State Houses of Assembly elections
sources.evidence: INEC published updated lists for the 2027 State House of Assembly elections, with documents organised by state. Separate files are listed for Lagos and Oyo. Open the state file first, then find the constituency heading.

sources.title: Full Election Calendar & Timetable
sources.evidence: The published calendar schedules the state assembly elections alongside governorship elections on 6 February 2027. The calendar schedules the presidential and National Assembly elections for 16 January 2027.

story.title: The 2027 presidential candidate list is out

sources.title: Updated list of candidates for 2027 presidential election
sources.evidence: INEC’s publication page links to the final presidential candidate list for the 2027 election.

sources.title: Full Election Calendar & Timetable
sources.evidence: The published calendar schedules the state assembly elections alongside governorship elections on 6 February 2027. The calendar schedules the presidential and National Assembly elections for 16 January 2027.

sources.title: Final List – Presidential
sources.evidence: The INEC list names 18 presidential tickets. It also includes an Accord entry marked “COURT ORDER” with neither nominee named. The presidential list pairs a candidate for president and a running mate on each named party ticket. The later INEC roster lists Adebayo Adewole Ebenezer as the SDP’s presidential candidate.
